findings.message: STREAMINFO says the stream holds 24000 samples, but its frames hold 28096, 4096 more.
The frame at 0x391F starts at sample 4096, but the frame before it ends at 8192: the frames overlap or are out of order.
The frame at 0x391F is 36 bytes long, outside the 2938 to 13857 bytes STREAMINFO states.
The frame at 0x391F has the CRC-16 0x879B, but 0xF010 is computed over it.
The frame at 0x391F cannot be read: the subframe of channel 1 starts with a bit the specification reserves as 0.
